A stale Amazon Creators API snapshot could also overwrite exact catalog data. The stale Creators API snapshot can no longer override an exact catalog ASIN. Release 309afe0 keeps direct buying language in the decision path, moves detailed source and non-hands-on methodology to the bottom, labels first-screen and sticky CTAs with a compact purchase-link line, and makes the entire responsive sticky bar clickable after the first CTA leaves view. The dock now works on desktop and mobile, hides at the footer and records sticky-bottom clicks separately.
conversionIntegrityP0.targetPage: The positions-by-age guide now exposes exact Omni Breeze commerce in the first viewport and links to ASIN B0931ZY7DK with tag madababy-20. The exact product review uses the same verified offer.
